scope: Named-organization deep dossier refresh for published H2 Analytics Inc., covering its EASE product, current Department of National Defence procurement, NRC IRAP-supported live-virtual-constructive simulation work, and independently reported defence-sector activity.

prospects.name: H2 Analytics
prospects.fitSummary: Published Ottawa company H2 Analytics has durable new public evidence for its EASE platform's detailed product workflow, an amended DND contract, NRC IRAP-supported LVC integration, and current Canadian defence-sector participation.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The official EASE product page resolves a concrete workflow for AI-enabled entity and intelligence-inject generation, external simulation integration, exercise control and after-action assessment.
CanadaBuys confirms the amended value, term, supplier, procurement method and DND buying organization for the current EASE software contract.
The NRC IRAP contribution record identifies a funded integrated LVC or simulation module for EASE, including value, period, legal recipient and purpose.

An Ottawa Business Journal and Invest Ottawa feature independently corroborates H2's Ottawa presence, EASE market, customer segments and growth milestones; individual performance counts remain attributed to that publication.

prospects.name: H2 Analytics DND EASE contract
prospects.fitSummary: CanadaBuys identifies a current, amended DND software contract for H2 Analytics' EASE platform; the public contract is retained inside the company's refresh bundle rather than becoming a standalone candidate.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The public record resolves contract number, vendor, buyer, procurement method, amendment, total value and term.

prospects.name: H2 Analytics NRC IRAP integrated LVC/simulation module
prospects.fitSummary: NRC IRAP identifies a specific H2 Analytics contribution to integrate simulation capabilities into EASE for readiness training; it is retained as a nested program in the published H2 refresh bundle.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: The official grants record resolves the legal recipient, agreement value, period, program, amendment history and intended EASE simulation-integration outcome.
